android.desc:
Welcome to the Jewelama - Match Jewels Combo game. A classic match 3 jewels game remake with new game mechanism, clear design, challenge mode and many levels. Tap and hold over the jewels with the same color, match 3 gems chain or more jewels to make a jewel combo. Use void white space to connect jewels not touching each other! Activate jewel bonuses to refresh jewels in different directions. If you are lost, just FLUSH it to reset the Jewelama level. Start your match 3 game Jewelama challenge today! If you love jewel match 3 game, forming chain of jewels or gems, you must try this one!

Game Features:
** Match 3 jewels game
** Challenging Jewelama gameplay
** Many randomized and themed levels
** Nice clear graphics 
** Relaxing music
** Achievements
** Challenge mode (high scores)
** Collecting jewel stars
** Bonus jewels
** Uses Google Play Services
** Jewelama is Free to play

TIP: You collect stars to open additional Jewelama levels. Stars are collected by making gem COMBOS of 4 or more jewels. Form as many combos as possible to receive 3 stars! Make a strategy to create not the longest chain but as many gem chains as possible. The number of combos needed to unlock next levels raises in each Jewelama level!

CHALLENGE: In the Challenge mode you have time limit to earn as many points as possible. When activating bonus jewels, time limit is increased a little. Submit your high score and compare it with Jewelama friends!

HEXAPOINTS: To unlock levels you can use stars or buy Hexapoints. Each Jewelama level has its value of Hexagoins that are needed to proceed. Simply tap on locked level to open Shop and purchase 3, 6 or 12 Hexapoints.

You can unlock achievements:
* Unlock levels using stars
* Finish the last level of themed level set
* Earn a total of 100 stars
* Activate a jewel bonus
* Submit high score in challenge mode

Thanks for your support and have fun with this "jewel match 3 game" Jewelama - Match Jewels Combo! Also give a review.
